title: AID Generation Authority Receipt
description: The SEALED, plan-scoped CP1 decision written once per plan by aid-auto-pipeline.sh before any generation output exists, and verified (never re-decided) by every phase generator via aid-plan-to-epic.sh --generation-authority. HONEST CLASSIFICATION (AID-v3 principles §1): this receipt is forgeable by a Bash-capable actor. The enforcement is the binding — plan bytes, target head, phase set, and the owning transaction's authority_sha256 — plus audit detectability, never actor impossibility.

plan_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact plan bytes the decision was made over.

target_head.description: Commit the target branch pointed at when the decision was sealed. EMPTY IS LEGITIMATE: fixture repos and fresh workspaces have no integration branch, and the verifier compares the sealed value against the freshly resolved one.

mode.description: queue mode the generation runs under (chain|separate|custom).

phase_derivation_version.description: Literal constant, bumped only when the pipeline's phase-detection algorithm changes semantically, so a resumed transaction can detect that a plugin upgrade changed how phases would be derived.

cp1.description: Either a clean verdict, or the bypassed conditions with their evidence references. A low-risk plan (gate exits 0 fast) carries a verdict, so the transaction contract is uniform across risk levels.

band.description: Ceremony band aid-cp1-gate.sh classified the plan into from its declared Files paths (P084). Recorded so an auditor can see which ceremony was owed, not just that the gate passed.

evidence_refs.description: Audit provenance at decision time: the paths of the C0 plan review and the cp1-deep evidence dir with their sha256s. The gate already validated those files; verification re-checks bytes only for the authority itself.

force_reason.description: The public --reason (>= 20 chars) recorded alongside the three P073 audit records. Null when the run was not forced.

self_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of this document with this field NULLED (`jq -S -c '.self_sha256 = null' | sha256sum`). A stated convention: nothing else in the tree hashes an embedded-self-field envelope, so producer and verifier both spell it out.
